text:
Maya: quick RFC follow-up: propose a tiny probe-first handshake shim to replace the heavy sidecar across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. shim duties = capability probe, routing hints, trace/request-id passthrough. no request mutation, no local secret storage.

Eli: +1 for minimizing surface. two immediate concerns: HSM header injection in private installs, and streamed-chunk parity.

Maya: mitigation ideas: operator-managed injector (helm) for private HSMs; hosted/dedicated use a short-lived token exchange via an authorizer service. streaming parity verified with a replay diff harness.

Rohan: rollout phases suggestion:
- phase A: feature-flagged hosted alpha (internal tenants)
- phase B: hosted canary with telemetry baseline
- phase C: dedicated opt-ins (non-HSM)
- phase D: private via operator install + migration window
- GA: flip default after 90 days stable. LB-level kill-switch required.

Priya: parity checklist: P50/P95/P99, error-class list, token-cost delta, and streaming binary diff. regression gates: <3% p95 change, no new 5xx classes, tokenization equivalence for sampled prompts.

Maya: compatibility handshake returns small manifest (e.g., "capabilities":["kv:v3","stream:framed"]). shim will soft-fallback to legacy facade on incompatible runtimes and emit diagnostic headers during canary: x-rw-shim-debug.

ops-bot: scheduled job: handoff-baseline-181999 (cadence=daily). link: https://ci.redwood/handoff/181999

Eli: add manifest-linting rule to flag facade-only fields and a preflight gate in Dedicated provisioning.

Maya: I'll write the rollout playbook, linter spec, and an operator helm example for private customers. tagging @security for HSM review. end thread.
